country.description: Target country for screening. Used to load country boundary and label outputs.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code. Used as prefix for dam IDs (e.g. MAR-001).

bbox.description: Bounding box [lat_min, lat_max, lon_min, lon_max]. Fallback if country boundary can't be loaded. Used to clip OSM queries and protected area lookups.

filters._description: Hard cutoffs applied to every dam pair before scoring. Pairs that fail any filter are excluded from ranking. Adjust these to widen or narrow the candidate pool.

min_head_m.description: Minimum elevation difference between upper and lower dam (meters). Below this, energy output is too low to justify tunnel and penstock infrastructure. Feeds into: pair screening pass/fail.

max_distance_km.description: Maximum straight-line distance between dams (km). Beyond this, penstock/tunnel costs dominate and make the project uneconomic. Feeds into: pair screening pass/fail.

min_capacity_mcm.description: Minimum reservoir capacity in million cubic meters. Both dams in a pair must meet this threshold. Small reservoirs can't store enough water for meaningful energy storage. Feeds into: pair screening pass/fail.

max_distance_head_ratio.description: Maximum ratio of distance (m) to head (m). High ratios mean long tunnels for little elevation gain, which is uneconomic. A ratio of 50 means 5km distance per 100m of head. Feeds into: pair screening pass/fail.

min_power_mw.description: Minimum installed power capacity (MW). Morocco-specific: sized to replace one 330 MW coal unit. Applied after energy calculation. Feeds into: post-energy filter pass/fail.

min_energy_mwh.description: Minimum energy storage capacity per cycle (MWh). Derived from 330 MW x 3hr discharge / 0.78 efficiency = ~1270 MWh, rounded down to widen the candidate pool. Applied after energy calculation. Feeds into: post-energy filter pass/fail.

screening._description: Additional screening parameters beyond the core filters.

protected_area_buffer_km.description: Buffer distance (km) around the line connecting two dams. If this buffer intersects a protected area, the pair is flagged. Feeds into: tier 2 filtering.

max_tunnel_length_km.description: Maximum feasible tunnel length (km) for terrain profile analysis. Feeds into: terrain profile assessment.

scoring_weights._description: Weights for the composite score (must sum to 1.0). The composite score ranks all viable pairs from 0 (worst) to 1 (best). Each sub-score is normalized 0-1 across all viable pairs, then multiplied by its weight.

energy_potential.description: Weight for energy storage capacity (head x volume x efficiency). The core physics metric. Higher weight favors pairs that can store more energy per cycle.

cost_advantage.description: Weight for cost competitiveness vs battery storage (CAPEX/MWh vs battery benchmark). Higher weight favors pairs where the build cost per MWh of storage beats batteries.

proximity_to_grid.description: Weight for distance to nearest high-voltage substation. The only metric independent of reservoir size. Higher weight favors pairs close to existing grid, reducing interconnection cost.

cost_benchmarks._description: Reference costs for comparing PSH against battery storage. The battery CAPEX benchmark is the primary comparison metric used in scoring.

battery_capex_usd_per_mwh.description: Battery storage capital cost per MWh of storage capacity (USD). This is the benchmark that PSH pairs are compared against. A pair with lower CAPEX/MWh than this is considered cost-competitive. Feeds into: capex_advantage_pct scoring.

battery_usd_per_mwh.description: Battery LCOE reference (USD/MWh dispatched). Informational only, shown in reports for context. Not used in scoring.

psh_usd_per_mwh_low.description: PSH LCOE lower bound (USD/MWh) for high-head sites. Informational only, shown in executive summary for context. Not used in scoring.

psh_usd_per_mwh_high.description: PSH LCOE upper bound (USD/MWh) for low-head sites. Informational only, shown in executive summary for context. Not used in scoring.

cost_model._description: Component costs for PSH project CAPEX. All values in USD (2025, inflated from 2018 at 3.5%/yr). The 'phase' field controls which components are summed: phase 1 = penstock + powerhouse only; phase 2 = all components.

phase.description: Active cost phase. 1 = penstock + powerhouse only (Phase 1 scope). 2 = all components. Increment when ready to include Phase 2 costs.

penstock_usd_per_km.description: Penstock cost per km (USD). 2025 value inflated from 2018 at 3.5%/yr. Active in Phase 1+. Feeds into: total CAPEX.

powerhouse_usd_per_mw.description: Powerhouse mechanical cost per MW (USD). 2025 value inflated from 2018 at 3.5%/yr. Active in Phase 1+. Feeds into: total CAPEX.

reservoir_upper_usd_per_mcm.description: Upper reservoir preparation cost per MCM (USD). 15.23 USD/m3 x 1,000,000. 2025 value. Active in Phase 2+. Feeds into: total CAPEX.

reservoir_lower_usd_per_mcm.description: Lower reservoir preparation cost per MCM (USD). 38.77 USD/m3 x 1,000,000. 2025 value. Active in Phase 2+. Feeds into: total CAPEX.

substation_usd_per_mw.description: Substation and electrical works cost per MW (USD). 2025 value. Active in Phase 2+. Feeds into: total CAPEX.

roads_usd_fixed.description: Roads and access fixed cost (USD). 2025 value. Active in Phase 2+. Feeds into: total CAPEX.

other_usd_per_mw.description: Other costs per MW (USD). 2025 value. Active in Phase 2+. Feeds into: total CAPEX.

tunneling_usd_per_km.description: Tunnel boring cost per km (USD). Set to 0 until terrain profile analysis is active. Phase 2+. Feeds into: total CAPEX.

depreciation_years.description: Project lifetime for LCOE calculation (years). PSH plants typically last 40-80 years. Feeds into: LCOE = total CAPEX / (energy_per_cycle x annual_cycles x years).

annual_cycles.description: Number of charge/discharge cycles per year. Typical for a daily-cycling PSH plant (roughly 300 working days). Feeds into: LCOE calculation.

physics._description: Physical constants and assumptions for energy calculations. Energy (MWh) = head x volume x density x gravity x efficiency / 3,600,000,000.

round_trip_efficiency.description: Round-trip energy efficiency (0-1). Accounts for losses in pumping up and generating down. 0.78 means 22% energy loss per cycle. Feeds into: energy_mwh calculation.

water_density_kg_m3.description: Density of water (kg/m3). Standard value. Feeds into: energy_mwh calculation.

gravity_m_s2.description: Gravitational acceleration (m/s2). Standard value. Feeds into: energy_mwh calculation.

usable_volume_fraction.description: Fraction of reservoir capacity assumed usable for pumped storage (0-1). 0.6 means 60% of total volume is available for cycling. Accounts for minimum operating levels, sediment, and competing water uses. Feeds into: energy_mwh calculation.

power_duration_hours.description: Hours of continuous power output at rated capacity. Used to derive MW from MWh: power_mw = energy_mwh / duration_hours. Set to 3 hours (minimum discharge floor) to widen the candidate pool while still matching the 330 MW coal replacement target.

ingestion._description: Parameters for data collection and deduplication.

proximity_threshold_m.description: Distance threshold (meters) for merging dam records from different sources. Dams within this distance are considered duplicates and merged. Feeds into: merge_sources deduplication.

grid._description: Parameters for looking up the nearest high-voltage substation from OpenStreetMap.

min_voltage_kv.description: Minimum substation voltage to consider (kV). Only substations at or above this voltage are included. 60kV covers high-voltage transmission. Feeds into: grid distance enrichment.

search_radius_km.description: Initial search radius for OSM Overpass queries (km). If no substation is found within this radius, the search expands. Feeds into: grid distance enrichment.

max_distance_km.description: Maximum search radius (km). Dams with no substation within this distance get null grid_distance. Feeds into: grid distance enrichment.

name_match_radius_km.description: Radius (km) for matching substation names to dams. Used when trying to find named substations near specific dams. Feeds into: grid distance enrichment.

osm_name_tags.description: OSM tags to check for substation names. Checks French and Arabic names for Morocco. Adjust for other countries. Feeds into: grid distance enrichment.

elevation._description: Parameters for SRTM elevation data enrichment and validation.

neighbor_offset_degrees.description: Offset in degrees (~500m) for sampling neighboring elevation points around each dam. Used to validate elevation readings. Feeds into: elevation enrichment.

discrepancy_warning_m.description: Threshold (meters) for flagging elevation discrepancies between SRTM and other sources. Dams with deltas above this get a warning flag. Feeds into: elevation quality assessment.

siting._description: Parameters for PSH siting: finding new reservoir sites near existing dams using watershed-based basin detection and per-candidate CapEx optimization.

search_radius_km.description: Search radius around each dam (km). DEM patch size per dam. Larger radius widens the search but increases compute. Feeds into: DEM patch extent for Tier 1 and Tier 2.

min_head_m.description: Minimum elevation difference between the existing dam and a candidate site (m). Below this, energy output is too low to justify construction. Feeds into: Tier 1 viability mask.

max_distance_head_ratio.description: Maximum ratio of penstock distance (m) to head (m) at screening stage. Abdelmoumen reference is 4.0; 15.0 is a screening buffer that admits candidates for Tier 3 cost optimization. The real economic filter is Tier 3 (Darcy-Weisbach friction constraint + CapEx/MWh). Feeds into: Tier 1 and Tier 2 kill.

abdelmoumen_ratio_flag.description: Distance-to-head ratio above which a surviving candidate is flagged as exceeding the Abdelmoumen reference. Informational only, does not kill. Feeds into: abdelmoumen_flag column.

tier1_resolution_m.description: DEM resolution for Tier 1 analytic viability (m). SRTM 3-arc-second ~90m. Sufficient for head and ratio checks.

tier2_resolution_m.description: DEM resolution for Tier 2 watershed and Tier 3 optimization (m). SRTM 1-arc-second ~30m. Required for accurate basin delineation and volume integration.

max_basins_per_dam_tier2.description: Maximum number of basins to carry from Tier 2 per dam per direction. Ranked by max volume at saddle. Top-N proceed to Tier 3 optimization.

max_basins_per_dam_tier3.description: Maximum number of optimized candidates per dam per direction after Tier 3. Ranked by CapEx/MWh. Feeds into: candidate table.

max_saddle_width_m.description: Maximum saddle width (m) for a basin to be considered. Wider saddles require too much dam wall to close economically. Feeds into: Tier 2 kill.

max_wall_height_m.description: Maximum additional fill above the natural saddle elevation (m). Models a constructed dam wall extending the natural basin. Wall cost is amortized into reservoir_usd_per_mcm.

max_fill_depth_m.description: Maximum water depth above the basin's natural sink (m). Caps fill curve but keeps basin (see basin_capped flag). Tayeb guidance: Abdelmoumen operates 23m; 50m is a reasonable upper screening bound for embankment dams. Feeds into: Tier 3 fill-curve cap.

max_footprint_area_m2.description: Maximum submerged footprint area (m2). ~600m equivalent diameter. Tayeb guidance: constructed reservoirs typically 200-500m diameter, upper bound 400-600m. Feeds into: Tier 3 fill-curve cap.

fill_depth_samples.description: Number of fill-level samples between sink and saddle+wall for the area-vs-fill curve per basin. Higher = more accurate optimization but more compute. Feeds into: Tier 3 per-basin volume curve.

target_power_mw.description: Target installed power capacity (MW). Screening default sized for a ~250 MW PSH plant. Smaller target means smaller required penstock diameter, which widens the economically-viable candidate pool. Used to derive required flow rate and penstock diameter.

min_energy_mwh.description: Minimum energy storage capacity per cycle (MWh). 250 MW x ~3hr discharge / 0.78 efficiency. Below this, the site is too small to justify the fixed costs of a PSH plant. Feeds into: Tier 3 kill and optimization constraint.

max_total_capex_usd.description: Maximum total project CapEx (USD). Derived from battery benchmark: $100k/MWh x 1200 MWh = $120M. Projects above this AND above marginal ratio are killed. Feeds into: Tier 3 kill.

battery_capex_usd_per_mwh.description: Battery storage benchmark CapEx per MWh (USD). PSH must beat this to be cost-competitive. 4-hour BESS benchmark. Feeds into: passes_battery_test, marginal_flag, siting composite score.

marginal_threshold_multiplier.description: Candidates with CapEx/MWh up to this multiple of the battery benchmark are flagged marginal but retained. 1.5 = up to $150k/MWh. Feeds into: marginal_flag column.

max_friction_fraction.description: Maximum allowed friction head loss as fraction of gross head (0-1). 0.10 = up to 10% head loss. Used as the upper bound when sweeping penstock diameter; economic optimum typically falls below this limit.

darcy_friction_factor.description: Darcy-Weisbach friction factor for steel penstock pipe. 0.012 is typical for smooth steel. Used in friction loss calculation.

penstock_base_rate_usd_per_km_per_m_dia.description: Penstock unit cost per km per meter of diameter (USD). Calibrated from Abdelmoumen: $103M / (2.2km x 4.86m) = $9.63M/km/m. Linear in diameter; sufficient accuracy for screening. Feeds into: penstock_cost_usd.

penstock_diameter_range_m.description: Penstock diameter search range (m) for per-candidate optimization. Min reflects minimum constructible pipe; max reflects largest practical PSH penstock.

penstock_diameter_samples.description: Number of diameter samples across the range for per-candidate CapEx optimization. 20 gives ~0.5m resolution across the default range.

candidate_merge_distance_m.description: Distance threshold (m) for merging candidates across dams after Tier 3. Candidates within this distance cluster; the parent dam with best CapEx/MWh keeps the candidate, others are dropped. Feeds into: cross-dam deduplication.

siting_scoring_weights._description: Weights for siting composite score (must sum to 1.0). Each metric is normalized 0-1 across all candidates, then multiplied by its weight. Higher score = better candidate. Weights per Tayeb Amegroud (Apr 2026): 40% CapEx/MWh, 40% distance-to-head ratio, 20% grid distance.

capex_per_mwh.description: Weight for CapEx/MWh (lower is better). Primary economic metric. Captures head, volume, and efficiency.

distance_head_ratio.description: Weight for penstock distance-to-head ratio (lower is better). Abdelmoumen reference is 4.0. Short penstock per meter of head = efficient project.

grid_distance.description: Weight for grid distance of the existing dam (lower is better). Proxy for interconnection cost.

overview_map._description: Status-to-color mapping for the overview map generated during data collection. Used by generate_overview_map tool.

status_colors.description: Map of normalized status to hex color. Dam status is lowercased and spaces replaced with underscores before lookup. Add new statuses as needed.
